quests.hint: Problem, impact, and the solution you want.
quests.explanation: A polite complaint has three parts: the problem, the impact, and the solution you want.
quests.partnerDialogue: Good morning. I understand you had an issue with your room?
quests.sampleAnswer: I did. Someone was loud next door until two. Could you move us?
acceptedSynonyms: i did. someone was loud next door until two. could you move us
yes, the room next door was very loud until two a.m. could we switch rooms
yes, unfortunately. the noise next door went on until two. is there another room
smartReplies: Yes, the room next door was very loud until two a.m. Could we switch rooms?
I did. Someone was loud next door until two. Could you move us?
Yes, unfortunately. The noise next door went on until two. Is there another room?
quests.correctAnswer: I did. Someone was loud next door until two. Could you move us?

quests.hint: Mention the pattern, not just one event.
quests.explanation: "Every evening" shows a pattern, which is more serious than a one-time problem.
quests.partnerDialogue: You've reached customer support. What can I do for you?
quests.sampleAnswer: My connection keeps dropping every evening. I'd like it fixed.
acceptedSynonyms: my connection keeps dropping every evening. i'd like it fixed
the internet cuts out every night. could someone look at it
i'm calling because my wi-fi keeps disconnecting in the evenings
my connection keeps dropping every evening. i would like it fixed
smartReplies: The internet cuts out every night. Could someone look at it?
I'm calling because my Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting in the evenings.
My connection keeps dropping every evening. I'd like it fixed.
quests.correctAnswer: My connection keeps dropping every evening. I'd like it fixed.

quests.hint: Show you understand the rule, then say why your case is different.
quests.explanation: Show you understand the rule, then explain why your situation is different.
quests.partnerDialogue: I'm sorry, we can't offer a refund on sale items.
quests.sampleAnswer: I understand, but this one is faulty. Could I speak to a manager?
acceptedSynonyms: i understand, but this one is faulty. could i speak to a manager
i see, but it's damaged. is there someone else i can talk to
that's fair for normal sale items, but this one doesn't work. can we discuss it
smartReplies: I see, but it's damaged. Is there someone else I can talk to?
That's fair for normal sale items, but this one doesn't work. Can we discuss it?
I understand, but this one is faulty. Could I speak to a manager?
quests.correctAnswer: I understand, but this one is faulty. Could I speak to a manager?

quests.hint: Apologize, then show action.
quests.explanation: A good service reply has apology plus action. Explaining why it happened can wait.
quests.partnerDialogue: We've been waiting forty minutes and nobody has taken our order.
quests.sampleAnswer: I apologize for the delay. I'll look after you now.
acceptedSynonyms: i apologize for the delay. i'll look after you now
you're right, and i apologize. what can i get you
i'm very sorry. let me take your order myself right now
i'm very sorry, let me take your order now
i apologize for the delay. i will look after you now
smartReplies: You're right, and I apologize. What can I get you?
I'm very sorry. Let me take your order myself right now.
I apologize for the delay. I'll look after you now.
quests.correctAnswer: I apologize for the delay. I'll look after you now.

quests.hint: Make a specific promise, not a vague one.
quests.explanation: A specific promise ("today") is more comforting than a vague apology.
quests.partnerDialogue: This is the second time my package has arrived damaged.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm sorry, that shouldn't happen twice. I'll send a replacement today.
acceptedSynonyms: i'm sorry, that shouldn't happen twice. i'll send a replacement today
i apologize. let me arrange a replacement straight away
that's not acceptable, and i'm sorry. i'll ship a new one today
i am sorry, that shouldn't happen twice. i will send a replacement today
smartReplies: I apologize. Let me arrange a replacement straight away.
I'm sorry, that shouldn't happen twice. I'll send a replacement today.
That's not acceptable, and I'm sorry. I'll ship a new one today.
quests.correctAnswer: I'm sorry, that shouldn't happen twice. I'll send a replacement today.

quests.hint: Apologize briefly, then ask for the information you need to help.
quests.explanation: To help someone, ask for the exact information you need. The apology keeps the tone calm.
quests.partnerDialogue: Your website charged me twice!
quests.sampleAnswer: Thanks for telling me. I'll look into it and refund the extra payment.
acceptedSynonyms: thanks for telling me. i'll look into it and refund the extra payment
i apologize. let me check your account and fix it
i'm sorry about that. can i have your order number so i can check
thanks for telling me. i will look into it and refund the extra payment
smartReplies: Thanks for telling me. I'll look into it and refund the extra payment.
I apologize. Let me check your account and fix it.
I'm sorry about that. Can I have your order number so I can check?
quests.correctAnswer: Thanks for telling me. I'll look into it and refund the extra payment.

quests.hint: Answer the actual fear in plain words.
quests.explanation: Answer their worry in plain words. "Honestly" shows that you mean it.
quests.partnerDialogue: I think I said something silly in the meeting.
quests.sampleAnswer: I doubt it. Honestly, nobody noticed.
acceptedSynonyms: i doubt it. honestly, nobody noticed
don't worry, it wasn't a problem at all
i'm sure it was fine. nobody seemed bothered
i doubt it
smartReplies: I doubt it. Honestly, nobody noticed.
Don't worry, it wasn't a problem at all.
I'm sure it was fine. Nobody seemed bothered.
quests.correctAnswer: I doubt it. Honestly, nobody noticed.

quests.hint: Reassure with a tip they can use if it happens.
quests.explanation: Reassurance with a small tip ("pause and breathe") feels more useful than "Don't worry".
quests.partnerDialogue: What if I forget everything in my speech?
quests.sampleAnswer: It happens to everyone. Pause, check your notes, and carry on.
acceptedSynonyms: it happens to everyone. pause, check your notes, and carry on

you've practiced a lot. if you lose your place, take a breath
you won't, and if you do, just pause and breathe
smartReplies: You won't. And if you do, just pause and breathe. Everyone does.
You've practiced a lot. If you lose your place, take a breath.
It happens to everyone. Pause, check your notes, and carry on.
quests.correctAnswer: It happens to everyone. Pause, check your notes, and carry on.

quests.hint: Use a general truth to comfort them without promising the future.
quests.explanation: Speak in general truths ("kids adapt") to reassure without promising something you can't guarantee.
quests.partnerDialogue: I'm worried the kids won't like the new school.
quests.sampleAnswer: Change is hard, but they'll probably make friends soon.
acceptedSynonyms: change is hard, but they'll probably make friends soon
they'll be nervous at first, but kids adapt quickly
it might take some time, but they'll settle in
smartReplies: Change is hard, but they'll probably make friends soon.
They'll be nervous at first, but kids adapt quickly.
It might take some time, but they'll settle in.
quests.correctAnswer: Change is hard, but they'll probably make friends soon.

quests.hint: Give one thing you liked and one that let you down.
quests.explanation: A "but" between a positive and a negative makes an opinion sound fair and detailed.
quests.partnerDialogue: What did you think of the film?
quests.sampleAnswer: The acting was great, but the ending disappointed me.
acceptedSynonyms: the acting was great, but the ending disappointed me

smartReplies: I liked the acting, but the ending felt rushed.
The acting was great, but the ending disappointed me.
Good performances, though the ending was a bit rushed.
quests.correctAnswer: The acting was great, but the ending disappointed me.

quests.hint: Prepare the listener for a "but".
quests.explanation: "In some ways" prepares the listener for a "but". It's a natural way to give a mixed view.
quests.partnerDialogue: Do you think working from home is a good idea?
quests.sampleAnswer: In some ways, yes. But I miss talking to my colleagues.
acceptedSynonyms: in some ways, yes. but i miss talking to my colleagues

smartReplies: It saves time, but I miss the office atmosphere.
In some ways, yes. But I miss talking to my colleagues.
It's convenient, but I feel a bit isolated.
quests.correctAnswer: In some ways, yes. But I miss talking to my colleagues.

quests.hint: An honest recommendation includes a downside.
quests.explanation: An honest recommendation includes the downside, and the listener trusts you more.
quests.partnerDialogue: Is that restaurant worth trying, do you think?
quests.sampleAnswer: Yes, I'd go. It's pricey, but the food's excellent.
acceptedSynonyms: yes, i'd go. it's pricey, but the food's excellent

yes, i would go. it is pricey, but the food's excellent
smartReplies: Yes, I'd go. It's pricey, but the food's excellent.
I think so. A bit expensive, but really good.
Definitely. It's not cheap, but the portions are huge.
quests.correctAnswer: Yes, I'd go. It's pricey, but the food's excellent.

quests.hint: Pick the worst moment and say why it was bad.
quests.explanation: A story detail ("my phone died") explains why something was bad.
quests.partnerDialogue: What was the worst part of your trip?
quests.sampleAnswer: Getting lost at night. My phone died and I had no map.
acceptedSynonyms: getting lost at night. my phone died and i had no map

definitely getting lost. my phone battery died
smartReplies: Losing my way after dark. My phone was dead.
Definitely getting lost. My phone battery died.
Getting lost at night. My phone died and I had no map.
quests.correctAnswer: Getting lost at night. My phone died and I had no map.

quests.hint: Answer the question, then give one impression, good and bad.
quests.explanation: "Once" answers "Have you ever...?" and adds a limit. Then give one impression.
quests.partnerDialogue: Have you ever been to a live concert?
quests.sampleAnswer: Once, last year. I loved it, though it was very crowded.
acceptedSynonyms: once, last year. i loved it, though it was very crowded

Once, last year. I loved it, though it was very crowded.
Yes, I went last summer. Amazing, but I couldn't move!
quests.correctAnswer: Once, last year. I loved it, though it was very crowded.

quests.hint: Describe something hard that still gave you something.
quests.explanation: Describing a hard experience with a positive outcome makes your story feel balanced.
quests.partnerDialogue: What was your first job like?

Hard work, but useful. I learned how to deal with customers.
Tiring, but I learned a lot. My boss was strict but fair.
quests.correctAnswer: Hard work, but useful. I learned how to deal with customers.

quests.hint: Refuse and give a reason in one breath.
quests.explanation: Refuse and give a reason at once. It's easier to accept than a vague "no".

smartReplies: Honestly, I'm done. Early morning tomorrow.
I'll pass. I have to be up early.
No, thanks. I have an early start tomorrow.
quests.correctAnswer: No, thanks. I have an early start tomorrow.

quests.hint: Use a phrase that is firm but gentle.
quests.explanation: "I'd rather not" is a firm but gentle refusal. It works well when the reason is personal.
quests.partnerDialogue: Can I borrow your car this weekend?
quests.sampleAnswer: Sorry, I'd rather not lend it. I need it myself.
acceptedSynonyms: sorry, i'd rather not lend it. i need it myself

smartReplies: I'd rather not. I'm using it a lot this weekend.
Sorry, I'd rather not lend it. I need it myself.
I can't, sorry. I have plans for it.
quests.correctAnswer: Sorry, I'd rather not lend it. I need it myself.

quests.hint: You don't owe an answer. How do you say so without offending?
quests.explanation: You can decline a personal question without apologizing too much. "That's private" is clear and calm.
quests.partnerDialogue: Come on, how much do you earn?

i would prefer not to say. it is private for me

I'd prefer not to say. It's private for me.
That's a bit personal. I'd rather not say.
quests.correctAnswer: I'd prefer not to say. It's private for me.

quests.hint: State the problem briefly, then suggest a solution.
quests.explanation: State the problem briefly, then suggest a solution. Don't make it sound like a complaint.

quests.hint: Choose a day and give a short reason.

That's very soon. Could I have until two?
Noon is tight. Would two o'clock be possible?
quests.correctAnswer: Noon is tight. Would two o'clock be possible?

quests.hint: Take action instead of asking permission.

quests.hint: Make the offer sound optional so they don't feel embarrassed.

quests.hint: Ask something specific so they explain instead of just venting.
